topic: Fat Loss Without Quitting Indian Meals
caption:
Roti aur chawal chhodne ki koi zaroorat nahi hai bro!
Fat loss ke liye extreme diet nahi, sahi daily habits ki zaroorat hoti hai.
Ghar ka khana khao, steps poore karo, aur achhi neend lo.
Aap din mein average kitne steps walk karte ho?

Follow karo @ctrl_thoughts_ for daily fitness ideas.
